The median only handles odd-length arrays; even-length cases need the average of the two middle values. Fixing that.`node test.js` passes.

The bug was in `median`: it always returned the upper middle element. For even-length arrays it now returns the average of the two middle values, matching the expected definition.
thought: The `median` function in `broken.js` only returns the middle element. This works for odd-length arrays but fails for even-length ones.
